name: Red Lentil Dhal
list: 150g Red Lentils, 1 Onion, 2 Garlic Cloves, 1 tsp Turmeric, 100g Rice.
info: Boil lentils with turmeric. Fry onion/garlic and stir in. Serve with rice.

name: Pasta Arrabbiata
list: 150g Penne Pasta, 1/2 tin Chopped Tomatoes, Chilli Flakes, 1 Garlic Clove.
info: Boil pasta. Simmer tomatoes with garlic and chilli. Toss together.

name: Sausage & Bean One-Pot
list: 3 Sausages, 1/2 tin Baked Beans, 1 Onion, 2 Potatoes (cubed).
info: Brown sausages and onions. Add potatoes and beans. Simmer until soft.

name: Chickpea Curry
list: 1 tin Chickpeas, 1/2 tin Tomatoes, 1 Onion, 1 tbsp Curry Powder, 100g Rice.
info: Fry onion and curry powder. Add chickpeas and tomatoes. Serve over rice.

name: Jacket Potato & Beans
list: 1 Large Baking Potato, 1/2 tin Baked Beans, Small knob of Butter.
info: Prick potato and bake at 200°C for 1 hour. Top with hot beans.

name: Simple Cheese Omelette
list: 3 Eggs, 30g Cheddar Cheese, Splash of Milk, Handful of Lettuce.
info: Whisk eggs and milk. Fry until set, add cheese, fold. Serve with salad.

name: Tuna Pasta Bake
list: 150g Pasta, 1/2 tin Tuna, 1/2 jar White Sauce, 20g Cheese.
info: Mix cooked pasta, tuna, and sauce. Top with cheese and grill until bubbly.

name: Vegetable Stir-fry
list: 150g Frozen Mixed Veg, 1 Nest of Noodles, 1 tbsp Soy Sauce, 1cm Ginger.
info: Fry veg and soy sauce on high heat. Add noodles at the end.

name: Egg Fried Rice
list: 150g Cooked Rice (cold), 2 Eggs, 50g Frozen Peas, 1 tbsp Soy Sauce.
info: Fry peas and rice. Move to side, scramble eggs in pan, then mix all together.

name: Lentil Cottage Pie
list: 100g Lentils, 1 Carrot (diced), 1 Onion, 2 Potatoes (mashed), Beef Stock Cube.
info: Cook lentils/veg in stock. Top with mash and bake at 190°C for 20 mins.

name: Chicken Thigh traybake
list: 2 Chicken Thighs, 1 Potato, 1 Carrot, 1 tsp Dried Herbs, 1 tbsp Oil.
info: Chop veg. Toss everything in oil and herbs. Roast at 200°C for 35 mins.

name: Sardines on Toast
list: 2 Slices of Bread, 1 tin Sardines in Tomato Sauce, Squeeze of Lemon.
info: Toast bread. Lightly mash sardines on top and warm under the grill.

name: Pesto Pasta
list: 150g Pasta, 2 tbsp Green Pesto, 1 tbsp Pasta Water, 5g Parmesan (optional).
info: Boil pasta. Reserve a little water. Mix pasta with pesto and water.

name: Black Bean Quesadilla
list: 2 Tortilla Wraps, 1/2 tin Black Beans, 30g Cheese, 1/2 tsp Cumin.
info: Mash beans on tortilla, add cheese, fold and fry until crisp.

name: Spanish Omelette
list: 2 Eggs, 1 Potato (thinly sliced), 1/2 Onion, 1 tbsp Oil.
info: Fry potato/onion until soft. Pour eggs over. Cook low until set.

name: Minestrone Soup
list: 1/2 tin Tomatoes, 50g Small Pasta, 100g Frozen Veg, 1 Stock Cube.
info: Boil all ingredients in 500ml water until pasta is cooked (approx 10 mins).

name: Corned Beef Hash
list: 1/3 tin Corned Beef, 1 Large Potato (cubed), 1 Onion, 1 tsp Worcestershire Sauce.
info: Boil potatoes for 5 mins. Fry with onions and corned beef until crispy.

name: Pea & Mint Risotto
list: 100g Arborio Rice, 100g Frozen Peas, 1 Stock Cube, 1 tsp Dried Mint.
info: Add stock to rice slowly while stirring. Stir in peas and mint at the end.

name: Burrito Bowls
list: 100g Rice, 1/2 tin Kidney Beans, 50g Sweetcorn, 1 tbsp Salsa, 20g Cheese.
info: Layer rice, warmed beans, corn, and salsa. Top with cheese.

name: Bacon & Pea Pasta
list: 150g Pasta, 2 Rashers Bacon (chopped), 50g Peas, 1 tbsp Cream Cheese.
info: Fry bacon. Boil pasta with peas. Drain and mix with cream cheese and bacon.
